summary: Fixed the dashboard's 500-saturated status counters and finished the B445 VS Code embed integration blocked on dashboard.py. (1) Added dashboard.exact_status_counts(): one narrow read-only SQLite aggregate over tasks.(archived_at, status, worker_status) only -- never card_json, never a rendered row list -- reusing AITools.taskdb.canonical_status precedence exactly. DashboardProvider.get_exact_status_counts() exposes it; build_snapshot() now sources status_counts (pending/processing/review/blocked/finished/archived/active/stale) from this exact path when available, falling back to the historical bounded-row-length behavior only for test doubles that don't implement it (FakeProvider tests unchanged). Added snapshot['row_counts'] with {returned, exact, truncated} per status for bounded-vs-exact transparency; dashboard.js/index.html untouched (out of allowed_writes) and unaffected -- it only reads status_counts[metric], which stayed the same shape. (2) Added dashboard.py's one explicit VS Code embed document at exact path GET /embed/vscode (no query params): same index.html/dashboard.js body as '/', but the only response that omits X-Frame-Options and widens CSP frame-ancestors to 'vscode-webview: https://*.vscode-cdn.net' (desktop Electron + web/Remote-SSH-tunneled VS Code) -- every other CSP directive and every other route (including /api/* and mutation endpoints) is untouched and keeps X-Frame-Options: DENY / frame-ancestors 'none'. (3) extension.js now resolves vscode.env.asExternalUri against the dashboard URL with '/embed/vscode' appended (embedUrlString()), never the plain root, still no LAN IP/token/second data model -- README.md's former 'Known limitation' section is replaced with a description of the resolved embed mechanism. Reproduced the bug with a real taskdb fixture of 501 finished cards (test_exact_status_counts_reports_totals_past_default_task_limit): exact_status_counts() and build_snapshot()['status_counts']['finished'] both report 501 (> DEFAULT_TASK_LIMIT=500), row_counts['finished'] == {returned:0, exact:501, truncated:true}, and the queue row count is unchanged after the read (502 before and after). Four new header tests prove ordinary pages/API/mutation endpoints keep DENY/frame-ancestors 'none', the embed route's CSP is narrowly scoped and every other directive is unchanged, query params and unrelated paths never pick up the relaxed policy, and arbitrary Host/Origin values are still rejected on the embed route exactly as elsewhere.

reproduction.bug: status_counts['blocked'/'finished'/'archived'] were computed as len(data_provider.list_tasks(status, limit=DEFAULT_TASK_LIMIT)), i.e. capped at 500 regardless of the true queue size.
reproduction.fixture: 501 finished + 1 pending card inserted directly into a real temporary taskdb SQLite file (no second database -- same schema/open_db/init_db/canonical_status as production).
reproduction.before_semantics_reproduced: with the old len(list_tasks('finished', limit=500)) path, a bounded read-only list of finished rows would be truncated to 500 regardless of the underlying 501 total (DashboardProvider.list_tasks/core.list_tasks caps via taskctl --limit).

exact_counts.note: row_counts[status] = {returned, exact, truncated} exposed alongside status_counts; blocked/finished/archived never return per-row payloads (returned=0 always), only exact totals -- unchanged from before for row payloads, fixed only for counts.
